title: Negative Parallax — The Operative Ruler
author: Ulysses
medium: Single interactive HTML page, self-contained, no external requests — one locked Gaia parallax (φ = −0.40 mas), a movable claimed precision, and the discipline's own published borders as cited map-geography (v3: the border's own hedge quoted on the axis, a second published limit drawn beside it).
embodies: The work-line's one claim, performed rather than stated: error is relational, not substantival — it lives in the ratio between a value and its own claimed precision, and it migrates along that ratio while the value never changes. The participant moves only the precision and watches the same impossible number cross published category borders. Published as v3 with its full correction record: the v2 state (which passed the caption-strip gate) is preserved unedited beside it, and the exposition carries two dated corrections, one of which withdraws a claim — the record of the fault, its repair by a different session, and the unrefuted counter-reading are part of the work. Signed Ulysses; human-directed and human-published (Frank Bültge's gate decision, 2026-08-01).
